chunks.title: Allied Climate Partners (ACP) (Allied Climate Partners) COP31 Role & Commitments
chunks.text: Allied Climate Partners (ACP) is a Institutional / Catalytic / Climate PE headquartered in United States (Philanthropic Catalytic Investor). At UNFCCC COP31 in Antalya (November 9-20, 2026), its verified role is: Founding cohort member of the GFANZ Catalytic Capital Repository launched at COP31 Antalya. Verified COP31 2026 climate finance commitment: Early-stage philanthropic catalytic equity & development capital unlocking bankable climate infrastructure pipelines in emerging markets. Source verification: https://www.esgdive.com/news/platform-launched-at-cop31-aims-to-scale-transition-capital-in-emerging-mar/874527/.

chunks.title: Allied Climate Partners Financing Instruments & Ticket Bounds
chunks.text: Allied Climate Partners (ACP) provides the following climate financing instruments: Early-Stage Development Equity, Catalytic First-Loss Capital, Project Preparation Funding, Co-Development Platform. Typical transaction ticket range is USD 1,000,000 to USD 25,000,000. Eligible applicant profiles include: Climate-Tech Startup, Project SPV, Fund Manager, Project Developer.

chunks.title: Allied Climate Partners Priority Climate Sectors & Regional Mandate
chunks.text: Priority climate sectors funded by Allied Climate Partners (ACP): Renewable Energy, Energy Storage, Electrification & Grid, Clean Transport, Climate Adaptation & Resilience, Climate-Tech Innovation. Target geographic focus includes: Emerging Markets, Developing Countries, Africa, Asia, Latin America, Caribbean. Projects outside primary regions or ticket bounds may require syndicated or on-lending structures.

chunks.title: Allied Climate Partners Mandatory Form & Underwriting Requirements
chunks.text: Mandatory requirements to complete Allied Climate Partners's application form: Early-stage / pre-FID bankability gap in emerging markets; High downstream commercial capital mobilization potential; Experienced local/regional project development team; Clear measurable tCO2e abatement or resilience impact. Explicit exclusion rules: Fossil-fuel generation; Developed-market-only deployments. Official application portal: https://www.alliedclimatepartners.org/.

chunks.title: Allied Climate Partners Form Template: Climate Private Equity / Catalytic Capital / Venture Investment Intake Form
chunks.text: Allied Climate Partners (ACP) uses the 'Climate Private Equity / Catalytic Capital / Venture Investment Intake Form' workflow governed by GFANZ Catalytic Capital Repository / Impact Management Project (IMP) / IRIS+ Climate Metrics. Typical review timeline is 4–10 weeks (Pitch Screening -> Commercial & Climate DD -> IC Approval). Form sections required: 1. Venture / Asset Overview, 2. Investment Thesis, 3. Product & Execution, 4. Impact & Risk, 5. Executive Pitch.
